evidence: Touches `src/index/base.cpp`, `src/index/txindex.cpp`, `src/index/blockfilterindex.cpp`, `src/index/coinstatsindex.cpp`, and `src/index/txospenderindex.cpp`, altering how secondary indexes handle read errors and corrupted records.
rationale: Prevents secondary indexes from silently running with corrupted records after LevelDB read failures. As noted in the description, a corrupt txindex read previously failed an individual RPC while allowing the node to proceed with damaged state rather than triggering fatal error handling.
